description: Defines an abstract callback class for handling responses from LwM2M requests, including logging success and error responses, with support for versioned IDs.

classes.name: TbLwM2MTargetedCallback
classes.description: An abstract callback class for handling LwM2M request responses, with logging for success and failure, supporting versioned IDs.

methods.name: onSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful responses; logs bad responses if response code indicates an error.

methods.name: logForBadResponse
methods.description: Logs error or success messages based on response code, including client endpoint, request name, versioned ID(s), and response string.
